visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: removeEldestEntry Instead of Manual Eviction
visualizerParams.problemDescription: After every put, a helper checks the size and removes the eldest key by hand. Let the map do it by overriding removeEldestEntry in a small subclass. The output must stay the same.

solution.explanation: removeEldestEntry is the hook the map calls after every insertion, so the eviction rule is part of the cache itself. Callers just use put, and nobody can forget to call the helper.
